mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits tyramine metabolism and can potentiate ramipril's antihypertensive effects while increasing risk of hypertensive crisis if dietary tyramine is consumed; ACE inhibitors may also enhance serotonergic activity when combined with MAOIs.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if unavoidable, use lowest ramipril dose with careful blood pressure monitoring and strict dietary tyramine restriction; consider alternative antidepressant or antihypertensive agents.
